description: List all downloadable files for a Zenodo record. Returns filename, MIME type, size in bytes, checksum (MD5), and a direct download URL for each file. Zenodo records can contain multiple files (data CSVs, code archives, supplementary PDFs, images, etc.). Use zenodo.records.search or zenodo.records.detail to find the record ID, then call this tool to get the file manifest with direct download links. All files in open-access records are freely downloadable without authentication.

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return (default 50, max 100).

record_id.description: Zenodo record ID whose files to list (numeric, e.g. 10487285). Obtain from zenodo.records.search or zenodo.records.detail.

name: zenodo.records.files

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: List Zenodo Record Files
